expected_manifest.mapping: Generic I1c registry consumes repo_id/revision/artifacts path,size_bytes,sha256 and immutable manifest digest. git_blob_sha1 is a payload Git hash only; lfs_pointer_git_blob_sha1 is retained publisher pointer provenance, never a downloaded payload hash. Generic leading-dot/zero-byte support and protected lifecycle receipt sealing remain I1c seams; no per-model branching.

column_mapping.git_blob_sha1: git_blob_sha1 for Git payloads; lfs_pointer_git_blob_sha1 for LFS pointer provenance

upstream_manifest.sha_semantics: For LFS, sha256 is publisher blob metadata; git_blob_sha1 identifies the pointer, not payload. For ordinary Git files, SHA256 was computed from fetched content and Git blob SHA1 matched metadata. Only 15 small nonweight files were fetched. No tensor header or weight payload was fetched. Empty safetensors-md5sum.txt is inventoried, not an integrity authority.
